Npcap was not found on this computer. The meter needs it to read the game's traffic.

To install it:
1. Download Npcap from https://npcap.com.
2. During setup, check "Install Npcap in WinPcap API-compatible Mode".
3. Do NOT check "Restrict Npcap driver's access to Administrators only": with that option the meter can't listen to the game without administrator rights.
4. Open the meter again.

The meter will close now.

site.pending.defaults.text: With your account connected, uploading your boss fights is on, and so are your presence on the ranking and your character name. It is used to keep your history on the site and build the ranking, which is public. Each uploaded fight comes with a public link: anyone with the address sees it, with each player by class and combat power, and the name only of those who show their name on the ranking. Uploading only starts after you accept this notice. To turn it off with 1 click: Settings › Account and upload › Turn off uploading (or keep fights Private there).

site.pending.inspect.text: When you inspect another player in the game, the meter reads what the game already shows (name, class, level, items, titles, legion, Arcana and Daevanion) and sends it to the site, together with the region, the server and the character's id, which never appear. The character's public page shows this data when they have an AionCore account and show their name. For people who have never used AionCore, the reading is kept without being shown: it does not become a page or appear in search. Anyone who does not want it hides the name or removes the character through the site's form. The site keeps which account sent the reading, without showing it, and deletes everything 180 days after the last reading. Sending is on by default: accepting or closing this notice does not turn it off. To turn it off with 1 click, use the button below (or later, in Settings › Account and upload › Send inspections to the site). Turning it off is free.

site.praise_consent.lead: It's optional and separate from uploading fights and from the DPS ranking: you choose whether to take part. Only for people aged 18 or over. Taking part means accepting everything written here: if any point doesn't work for you, don't take part.
site.praise_consent.leave: You can leave whenever you want, here. Leaving deletes your praise on the site right away; the public board stops showing it within 1 hour, and the hosting backups disappear within 30 days. Leaving does not take the praise count read from the game's inspection off the public profile: you turn that off in My account, under Show the game data on my profile. While you take part, the history (one record per character per day) is kept for at most 180 days; a character with no new reading for 60 days leaves the board and, after 180 days, is deleted; and an account unused for 180 days is deleted along with everything. You can request access, correction, a copy and deletion of the data, and make any request or report, through the page aioncore.app/contato. Full policy: aioncore.app/privacidade#elogios.
site.praise_consent.never: Other players' names or praise, chats, the IP address, combat power and your fights (they only go through fight upload, if you turn it on). The Discord name and identifier never appear in the praise ranking. What you send here does not go to your DPS ranking profile. But your character's public profile shows the count of each type of praise and the total that the game's inspect window shows to any player, read by the meter of whoever inspects you and not by this upload. This is part of the game data on the profile, which is on by default and which you turn off in My account, on the site, under Show the game data on my profile. Anyone who compares the class and total on the profile with the praise board can conclude it is the same character.
site.praise_consent.never_label: What is never sent or shown
site.praise_consent.purpose: Purpose: to build and show the praise ranking on the site and give the badge to those in the top 20. Legal basis: your consent (LGPD, art. 7, I), which you can withdraw whenever you want. Controller: Guilherme Filvoch, author of AionCore, an individual.
site.praise_consent.shows: The meter reads, on your PC, only your own character's praise and sends the site: the character's name, the server, the region, the class, the count of each of the five praise types, the time the game reported it and the meter version. Everything is linked to your site account. On the public board, which opens without logging in, the first letter of the name with an asterisk, the class, the total and the position appear, separated only by region; the server does not appear. For someone who plays with you, that may be enough to recognize you. Those who pay to support AionCore see the full name of the characters in the ranking; this access is one of the support benefits. A supporter can write down or screenshot what they saw, and AionCore can't delete those copies. The time of the reading never appears in public. The data stays on Cloudflare's servers, which may be outside Brazil.
site.praise_consent.shows_label: What is sent and who sees it
site.praise_consent.title: Take part in the praise ranking
site.praise_consent.verify: The numbers are read from the game by your meter, and the site can't check them: they appear as declared by the meter, not verified. Only send your own character. Unusual numbers stay under review and off the board, the top 20 go through a manual review, and the same name sent by two accounts stays hidden for everyone until the doubt is resolved. False data removes you from the ranking.
site.inspect_consent.title: Send inspections to the site
site.inspect_consent.lead: It is on by default, separate from uploading fights, and free to turn off. When on, the characters you inspect in the game can get a public page on the site with what the inspection window shows, including characters of people who do not use AionCore: the page opens with the inspection of one account. Turn it off here if you do not agree.
site.inspect_consent.purpose: Purpose: to show on the public profile the character the way the game itself shows it to any player. Legal basis: for your part, the AionCore terms of use and the notice you saw, with the feature on by default and free to turn off (LGPD, art. 7, V); for the inspected character, AionCore's legitimate interest (art. 7, IX). Controller: Guilherme Filvoch, author of AionCore, an individual.
site.inspect_consent.shows_label: What is sent and who sees it
site.inspect_consent.shows: From the character you inspect: the name, class, level, item level, combat power, title, equipped titles, the Legion (the name as text, as the game shows it in the inspection), the equipment (each piece with its enhancement, stones, extra attributes, effects and chosen appearance), the Arcana, the Daevanion and the number of each type of praise. Anyone sees this data on the character's page, without logging in, with the day of the reading. Also sent, without being shown: the region, the server and the character's identifier in the game, only so the site knows it is the same character, even after a name change.
site.inspect_consent.never_label: What is never sent or shown
site.inspect_consent.never: The list of Legion members, the character's face and body, the dye colors, conversations, the time of the inspection and who inspected. The server and the Discord name are never shown.
site.inspect_consent.yours: About you: the site keeps which account sent the latest reading of each character and, when there is one, which account sent a different reading not yet confirmed, only to check reports of false data. This is never shown, changes with the next readings and is erased with your account. Send only what the game showed: a fake or altered inspection is forbidden and leads to losing the upload.
site.inspect_consent.others: Whoever does not want the page can remove it for free, without an account and without proof, through the form on /ranking, and no new inspection with that name puts it back. The numbers are read by your meter, and the site cannot check them against the game.
site.inspect_consent.leave: You can turn it off whenever you want, here. Once off, the meter stops sending immediately. The readings you already sent stay on the characters' pages until the next reading or until the 180-day limit, because they are game data of those characters. Full policy: aioncore.app/privacidade#ranking.

site.first_access.title: Two options for you to decide now
site.first_access.lead: If you create a new account now, these two options come checked: taking part in the praise ranking and publishing your build. Nothing is turned on before you press the button. Uncheck one or both here, with one click, and connect all the same. When you press the button, whatever is checked applies.
site.first_access.praise: Praise ranking: the character's name, the server, the region, the class and the count of each praise type are sent. On the public board, which opens without logging in, the first letter of the name with an asterisk, the class, the total and the position in the region appear; the server does not appear. AionCore supporters see the full name. People who play with you may recognize the character.
site.first_access.build: Publish my build: from the character that is in the game, the active and passive skills with their level, the chosen specialization, the equipped skills and the stigma start to appear on the character's public profile, for anyone, without logging in. It is only the current build, with no history. Other players' builds are never sent.
site.first_access.age: The account and the praise ranking are only for people aged 18 or over. By pressing the button you declare that you are 18 or over. If you are under 18, do not connect.
site.first_access.purpose: Purpose: for the praise ranking, to build and show the ranking and give the badge to the top 20; for the build, to show your build on your public profile. Legal basis for each option: your consent (LGPD, art. 7, I), which you give by leaving the option checked and pressing the button, and can withdraw whenever you want, for free. Controller: Guilherme Filvoch, author of AionCore, an individual. The data is kept on Cloudflare's servers, which may be outside Brazil, and you also consent to that.
site.first_access.leave: You can turn them off whenever you want, for free: in AionCore Meter, in Settings › Account and upload, or on the site, in My account. Turning off the build erases it from the site right away; leaving the praise ranking erases your praise right away. The public page may take from 10 minutes to 1 hour to change. The acceptance is recorded with the notice version and the date.
site.first_access.existing: Accounts that already existed do not change: nothing is turned on in them. If you already have an account and connect again, what is checked here turns nothing on. To turn on one of the options, accept its text in Settings › Account and upload.
site.first_access.record: For each option that is checked when you press the button, the site records the version of this notice and the date, as proof of your acceptance, for as long as the account exists. An unchecked option stays off, with no record of acceptance.

site.build_consent.title: Publish my build
site.build_consent.lead: It is optional and separate from uploading fights and from the profile: you choose whether to publish. In the game, nobody sees your build when they inspect your character. Once published, it appears to anyone on your public profile.
site.build_consent.purpose: Purpose: to show your build on your public profile. Legal basis: your consent (LGPD, art. 7, I), which you can withdraw whenever you want, for free. Controller: Guilherme Filvoch, author of AionCore, an individual.

site.build_consent.never_label: What is never sent or shown
site.build_consent.never: The build of other characters, the presets and the shortcut bar, the time of the changes and your fights (they only go through fight upload, if you turn it on). The server and the Discord name are never shown.
site.build_consent.leave: You can turn it off whenever you want, here or in My account, on the site. Turning it off erases the build from the site right away, and the page can take up to 10 minutes to change. Hiding your name, turning off the profile or leaving the ranking take the build offline together with the profile, and it comes back if you turn them on again; to erase it, turn this option off. Deleting the account also erases the build. The site keeps your choice, the version of this text and the date, as proof, as long as the account exists. Full policy: aioncore.app/privacidade#ranking.

site.ranking.reconnect: The meter needs to be connected to the site again to use the ranking.
site.ranking_consent.lead: The ranking shows the whole group of each uploaded fight. With an account, you appear on it with your character name, and that starts on. You can hide your name or leave the ranking at any time, for free. Only for people 18 or older.
site.ranking_consent.leave: Hiding your name keeps you on the board with no name, for everyone, with the class, the combat power and the DPS. Leaving the ranking also removes the fight details and keeps the class, the combat power and the DPS, with no name. Removing from the ranking deletes your rows and the stored name, and no upload from a teammate puts you back, unless you join again; in fights a teammate uploads, you show only as a teammate, by class, with no numbers. Hiding, leaving and removing are free and apply to everyone, supporters included. The public board may take up to 10 minutes to update. The stored name is deleted 180 days after the last fight it appeared in, and an account unused for 180 days is deleted with everything. For access, correction, a copy or deletion of the data, use the contact page.
site.ranking_consent.never: The server, your Discord name and your e-mail. And, to no one, the name of anyone who hid their name or removed their character from the ranking.
site.ranking_consent.past: The eligible fights you already uploaded also show, under the same rules.
site.ranking_consent.purpose: What it is for: showing how people play, like a DPS network. Legal basis: the AionCore terms of use, which you accept when you create the account (LGPD, Art. 7, V); for teammates without an account, legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX). Controller: Guilherme Filvoch, author of AionCore, as an individual.
site.ranking_consent.shows: The DPS board and Fastest kill show the class, the combat power (the exact number), the DPS, the fight duration (to the second), the party size, the day, the verification badge and, for account holders who did not hide it, the character name, with the declared label. Fastest kill also shows the class of each group member. A teammate without an account shows with no public name; only AionCore supporters see their name. Anyone who hides their name has no name for everyone, supporters included, but the class, the combat power and the DPS stay visible. Even without the name, the exact combat power, together with the class and the fight, may be enough for people who play with you to know who you are. People who were in the group may recognize you by the fight, and people who saw it may have noted it or taken a screenshot. The data is kept on Cloudflare servers, which may be outside Brazil. For account holders, fight details (the highest-damage skills, the DPS curve, the crit and the healing per second) also start on and can be turned off in My account, for free.

site.ranking_consent.verify: The numbers are self-reported. The Verified by N badge shows that the fight existed with those numbers, because other accounts uploaded the same fight, and the witnesses don't need to take part in the ranking. It doesn't prove who played each slot, nor that AionCore checked the fight against the game, and two colluding accounts can fool it.

site.telemetry.notice.sample_details: Samples: only of packet types the meter doesn't understand yet and that the server asks for, at most 3 per type, up to 96 bytes each and the 3 neighboring packets (type and size only). Before anything leaves, every stretch that could be text is erased and the meter checks that no known character name is left; if it can't prove that, the sample is discarded. They are kept for up to 90 days. To request removal, send the code from the site-telemetry.json file through the contact page on the site.
site.telemetry.notice.text: AionCore sends anonymous technical reports (meter, Windows and .NET versions, capture state, the game packet types seen, error types, a signal every 5 minutes that the meter is open (only to count how many people use AionCore at the same time) and, for packet types the meter doesn't understand yet, statistics with numbers only) to improve the tool. Short packet samples, with all text erased, are only sent if you turn on the Unknown packet samples option; it is off by default. It does not include character names, chat or your fights. To turn it off: Settings › Privacy. Regardless of this switch, AionCore also sends game protocol data (numbers only: map object types it does not recognize yet and radar counters), without the installation code, character names or position, to fix the meter when the game changes; sending it is mandatory.

inst.npcap.missing.desc:
Npcap: NOT found. Without it the meter (AionCore Meter) cannot read the game; the HUD and the guide work normally.
   1. Click "Open npcap.com" and download the Npcap installer (the "Npcap ... installer" button).
   2. During setup, check "Install Npcap in WinPcap API-compatible Mode" and "Support loopback traffic".
   3. Finish and open AionCore. If the meter shows "Reopen as administrator" (Npcap for administrators only), accept; the permanent fix is to reinstall Npcap without checking "Restrict Npcap driver's access to Administrators only".

legal.firstrun.lead: Read this once: what the app is, how it reads the game and what it does with your data.

legal.firstrun.sec.faz.title: What AionCore does
legal.firstrun.sec.faz.sub: Reads the game’s network traffic on this PC. Never changes the game or plays for you.
legal.firstrun.sec.faz.body: AionCore reads the Aion 2 network traffic through Npcap, only on this computer, and works out what happens in the fight.
legal.firstrun.sec.faz.l1: Never changes the game or its files.
legal.firstrun.sec.faz.l2: Never reads the game’s memory. It only looks, without changing anything, at the window’s name and title, the install path and the version list in the game folder (to learn the version and the region).
legal.firstrun.sec.faz.l3: Never sends anything to the game’s server.
legal.firstrun.sec.faz.l4: Never plays for you: it sends no keystrokes or clicks to the game.
legal.firstrun.sec.pc.title: What stays on your PC
legal.firstrun.sec.pc.sub: Traffic in memory; history, settings and logs in the app folder.
legal.firstrun.sec.pc.body: These stay in files in the app folder, on this PC only: your fight history, your settings, the character names already seen, the checklist progress and the error logs (with no character names). The game traffic that is read stays in memory only and is discarded. Packets are saved to disk only if you turn on developer mode or record a moment.
legal.firstrun.sec.enviado.title: What is sent, to whom and when
legal.firstrun.sec.enviado.sub: Update check, anonymous counter and a technical report with no names. Fights only after you connect your site account.
legal.firstrun.sec.conta.title: Only with your site account
legal.firstrun.sec.conta.sub: With no account connected, no fight leaves your PC. When you connect, fight upload turns on by itself.
legal.firstrun.sec.conta.body: With no site account connected, no fight and no profile leaves your PC. When you connect, the upload of your boss fights turns on by itself, after a notice of its own, and you can turn it off in Settings › Account and upload. Other uploads (player inspection, your build, party applicant lookup) have their own switch and text, and your build is only sent if you turn that upload on.
legal.firstrun.sec.nunca.title: Never
legal.firstrun.sec.nunca.sub: Ads, selling data, character names or chat in the technical reports.
legal.firstrun.sec.nunca.body: AionCore has no ads, does not sell data and never puts a character name, chat or the contents of your fights into the technical reports.

support.note.title: A word from the author
support.note.text: AionCore is free, and whatever has already been released for free stays free. The meter calculates the same for everyone, whether they support or not. Thank you so much to everyone who supports: it's your support that pays for the domain, the site and the server, and gives me time for the next features. Supporters get new features first and a few exclusive visual items. And thanks as well to everyone who simply uses it and spreads the word: you make AionCore worth it.

settings.apoio.outros.desc: This is the same choice as Show my supporter badge, in My account, on the site: changing it here changes it there, and hiding the badge also applies to the ranking and the public profile. When you turn it off, the badge disappears from other players' meters within 30 minutes, and from the ranking and the profile within 10 minutes. Your support remains in effect.
settings.apoio.ver.desc: Free for everyone, with or without support. When on, the meter asks the site about the name and server of the players who appear in your meter (your party or whoever is fighting the same target), without saying who is asking. The answer stays only in memory, for up to 30 minutes or until you close the meter. The lookup does not return a list of supporters: only the badge of those who have one. When off, the meter asks nothing.
support.notice.title: Supporter badges
support.notice.lead: AionCore works like this: these two options come turned on. Accepting keeps them as they are. If you don't want one, uncheck it before accepting. You can change them later, anytime and for free, on the Supporter tab. If you support AionCore, by clicking Accept you also agree to item 4.10 of the Support terms, on the site, about the badge in other players' meters. If you do, your badge may have been showing to others since Oct 17, 2026. Unchecking it here hides it if the meter is connected to your site account; if not, hide it in My account, on the site.
support.notice.show.label: Show my badge to other players
support.notice.show.help: If you support AionCore with the code on your site account, show your character's name on the ranking, and the character is confirmed on the ranking by your fights, your badge shows in the meter list of the people who play with you (your party or whoever is fighting the same target), with the years of support, the founder mark and the crystal color. Without that, this option changes nothing.
support.notice.see.label: See others' badges
support.notice.see.help: The meter asks the site which of the players who appear in your meter (your party or whoever is fighting the same target) have a badge, sending only each one's name and server, up to 12 at a time, without your account and without your character's name. The answer stays only in the meter's memory, for up to 30 minutes or until you close the meter. When unchecked, the meter asks nothing.

support.notice.update.title: New: supporter badges in the meter
